mission.title: Whispers of Ones and Zeroes
mission.description: Monitor Agent Pace's meeting with the Cypherite Veil and examine the Zion data the Cypherites offer.

npc.say: You must monitor Agent Pace very carefully at the meeting. She is known to be...overly credulous.
Veil is deceptive, tesoro, but as long as you are there with me, I know that we will not be fooled!
Oh, you'll be examining our data? Marvelous, darling. I'm sure you'll get quite a kick out of it.
That was very easy, {player}! They seem very sincere in wanting to provide us with the information we require.

Hello, friend. The programs on these two computers were compiled with data from Zion's mainframe. I think you'll find them...colorful.
Go ahead, check them out.
If you are working for the Machines, then your mind was never truly free.
You killed the Assassin! I can only think of a handful of people who could have pulled that off...and one of them was Morpheus.
Stick to the most pertinent facts, operative.

It must have been a surprise to see a replica of Morpheus like that, tesoro! I would have liked to have met him. He was very dangerous, but before he left Zion to begin sabotaging the System, he was an inspiring leader for many people! It is a shame that his obsession with Neo's physical remains got the better of his reason. Still, we tried to honor his memory by placing his partial RSI reconstruction of Neo in Westview.

phase.briefing:
{player}, as you are aware, Zion countered our request for access to their mainframe with a demand for information from our databases. This demand has been...rejected.
Even in the event that Zion proves intractable, there may be other solutions to the problem of our lack of information on Zion's unsecured population. The Cypherites have contacted us, claiming to be able to access such information themselves. You will be meeting with one of their representatives. Agent Pace will brief you on your role.

enter.say: Man, how many people can say they've been briefed by Agent Pace?

talk.say:
Saluti, {player}! I am very glad that Agent Gray has allowed me to work with you again.
We still know very little about the Cypherites. Like many recent troublesome groups, they came from Zion, and appear to have maintained some secretive ties in Zion's caverns. They claim to want to return the System to a peaceful state, but we cannot be sure that they are trustworthy. Their representative with whom we will be meeting, Veil, has a particularly shady record. She is notorious in Zion for having allegedly betrayed and killed her hovercraft captain, but as the killer carried a different name and appearance at the time, this rumor cannot be confirmed. Still, we must be very careful when dealing with her.

done.say: A face-off between Pace and Veil? This is gonna be sick!

phase.briefing:
Agent Pace will precede you to the meeting, held at a neutral location.
You are to monitor the participants, particularly Veil.

enter.say: I've got Pace, another Agent, and three redpill signals in there.

talk.say: Of course, dearie. We don't expect you simply to take our word for it. We've arranged a few treats for you, straight from the Zion mainframe. We'll upload all the details to you immediately.
Oh! Grazie. We will be very happy to examine this sample of your resourcefulness.

done.say: Hm! Can they actually be getting along?

phase.briefing: It is time to test the Cypherite claims. Proceed to the indicated location. You will find some of their people there. Examine their data.

enter.say: I'm reading some redpills in there, and a secure network.

done.say: Let's see what's behind computer number one...
A Niobe simulacrum? Hey, and they got her new hairstyle and everything.
Uh-oh, I've got unknown redpills heading your way, fast!

talk.say: The Machines are hiding something--something to do with Neo--and I will not rest until he is with us again.

done.say: So ol' Morph was talking about us behind our backs, was he?

talk.say: I'll be damned if I'll see his good works ruined because the Council is too busy trying to please the Machines.

done.say: Ah, vintage Niobe. I wonder if she'd have that same attitude these days?
That's all the hostiles I had on my screen. Man, those EPN can be a pain.

phase.briefing: Agent Pace is awaiting your report on the Cypherite data, operative. Additionally, she will provide you with further information regarding our dealings with them.

enter.say: Maybe we should just ask Pace for her cell phone number. Then we wouldn't have to go through papa Gray every time we wanted to hook up with her.

talk.say:
The data the Cypherites showed you was very interesting, {player}! It seems very likely that it could have come from the Zion mainframe. Their claims of being able to provide us with further Zion mainframe data, then, could be true.
We have been aware that the E Pluribus Neo terrorists target Cypherites particularly. This may prove to be a difficulty when attempting to deal with data from the Cypherites. We will have to get further proof that they can provide the required information to us reliably.

mission.finish: As Agent Pace indicated, {player}, we must take a guarded approach with the Cypherites. They appear to have access to some restricted Zion data; the full reach of their data-gathering capabilities must be evaluated. Furthermore, we must ensure that interference by E Pluribus Neo terrorists will not make attempting to deal with the Cypherites unduly...inefficient.
